records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net product sales were $148,819 in second quarter 2024 compared to $158,837 in second quarter 2023, a decrease of $10,018 or 6.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Higher price realization, as well as a decrease in certain costs as discussed above, mitigated much of the adverse effects of lower sales volumes relating to second quarter and first half 2024 adjusted operating earnings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, second quarter and first half 2024 sales were impacted by customer inventory adjustments, which adversely affected customer orders and sales in second quarter and first half 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company faced a more challenging market in second quarter and first half 2024 as customers and consumers became more resistant to higher price realization which was necessary to restore our margins.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusting for these deferred compensation costs and expenses, adjusted earnings from operations were $17,927 and $19,684 in second quarter 2024 and 2023, respectively, a decrease of $1,757 or 8.9%; and adjusted operating earnings were $36,327 and $36,827 in first half 2024 and 2023, respectively, a decrease of $500 or 1.4%.
